title: CPI print beats forecasts — ES whips 25 handles in under a minute
summary: A hotter-than-expected inflation read sent index futures sharply lower before ripping back, stopping out breakouts on both sides.

title: Overnight liquidity thin ahead of the cash open — spreads wider than usual
summary: Low overnight volume left order books thin; expect choppier fills until the regular session gets going.

title: FOMC statement triggers a sharp two-sided reaction across index futures
summary: Futures spiked on the headline, then reversed hard within minutes as the market repriced the outlook for the next meeting.

title: Weekly jobless claims roughly in line with estimates
summary: Muted reaction across the majors — no meaningful follow-through in either direction.

title: Bond auction tails hard, yields spike — futures give back the week's gains
summary: Weak demand at the auction pushed yields higher into the close, dragging equity index futures with it.
